newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece, Ukraine sign cooperation treaty.
newsitem.headline: Greece, Ukraine sign cooperation treaty.

text.p: Greece and Ukraine signed a peace and cooperation pact on Monday intended to boost economic and security ties, the Greek foreign ministry said.
Visiting Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma and Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis told reporters after signing the treaty that both countries sought to improve already good ties.
"We have had close ties with Ukraine for many years," Simitis said. "Greece supports Ukraine's effort to find a new path, new ways of cooperation, in a new international environment."
The agreement was of a general nature and would be followed by others, more specific, on issues such as education, commerce and foreign affairs, Simitis added.
